summary: Medallion’s first property should preserve several proven practices while moving core operations into Entrata. The latest calls establish manual lead assignment; defined lead and applicant follow-up timing; next-month charge posting on the 25th; deposit-first payment allocation; full-current-balance resident payments; restricted staff access to resident payment credentials; certified funds at move-in; detailed transfer ledgers; budgeted-rent gross potential rent; electronic inspections, make-readies, and maintenance assignment; and hidden resident clubs. Later calls supersede the earlier partial-payment choice: require the entire current balance, not merely each selected charge, to be paid. Garden beds, maintenance auto-assignment, Homebody cutover, renewals, phone routing, collections, insurance household rules, and several legal/accounting details still require confirmation.

callsUsed.title: Medallion Management|Entrata
callsUsed.brief: The call involved discussions about college football, particularly Michigan vs. Ohio State, and a sales opportunity in Kalamazoo, Michigan, where the prospect uses outdated paper-based processes. Phone Caller #1 is working to secure the deal for Joseph, and they plan to reconnect after the Michigan game to discuss their expected victory. Sean offered to take bets on the game.

callsUsed.title: Medallion Management|Entrata
callsUsed.brief: "The call focused on exploring Entrata's software solutions for Medallion, a property management company specializing in affordable housing. Jared, a supervisor at Medallion, expressed interest in modernizing their paper-based processes, particularly in maintenance and work order management, and identified price as a key concern. The team agreed to schedule a demo with Jared and Alicia, a resident manager, to showcase Entrata's capabilities and discuss a potential implementation timeline.

callsUsed.title: Entrata + RMP Investing & River Caddis Group: Lead/Resident Management & Resident Experience
callsUsed.brief: Jaron from Entrata, along with Sara, Ryan and Scott, discussed the setup of Medallion Management's Entrata system, focusing on lead and resident management processes, including automated lead assignment, communication points, and non-progressing lead settings. They also reviewed resident experience features like move-in/move-out checklists, the resident portal, and delinquency and pre-collection notices, with a plan to continue discussions on payment types and recurring charges. Key decisions included setting a 7-day timeframe for non-progressing leads, establishing a $100 threshold for delinquency notices, and agreeing on automatic sending for various notices with customizable timing.

callsUsed.title: Entrata + RMP Investing & River Caddis Group: Ledgers: Charges & Payments Consultation
callsUsed.brief: Jaron from Entrata, along with Scott from Medallion Management, discussed the setup of Entrata's financial and charge code configurations for Medallion's properties. Key highlights included aligning charge codes, establishing payment settings, and defining how various fees and charges would be managed within the system, with a focus on ensuring accurate financial reporting and resident experience. They also scheduled a follow-up meeting to review the facilities product.

callsUsed.title: RMP / Entrata Accounting Pre-migration
callsUsed.brief: Lydia from Entrata, along with Casey, Tom and Ryan, discussed the accounting setup for Medallion Management, including decisions on accrual basis accounting, period closing settings, and Gross Potential Rent (GPR) configurations. Key decisions were made regarding automatic period advances and locking, with a preference for accrual basis accounting to align with River Caddis's requirements. The team also initiated discussions on bank account setup and the critical merchant account process, emphasizing the need for timely completion before migration.

callsUsed.title: Resident Verify (Screening) Consultation | RMP & River Caddis/Entrata
callsUsed.brief: Kaela and William from Entrata, along with Scott from Medallion Management, discussed the implementation of Entrata's screening system, focusing on manual processing preferences, credit and criminal background check criteria, and identity verification tools. Key decisions included setting a seven-day expiration for conditional offers, mirroring Beech Tree's existing screening packages, and establishing specific credit score thresholds and guarantor requirements. The team also reviewed criminal look-back periods and the use of manual criminal searches for certain states, ultimately agreeing to a seven-year lookback for felonies and misdemeanors.

callsUsed.title: Entrata + RMP Investing & River Caddis Group: Facilities Pro Consultation
callsUsed.brief: Jaron from Entrata, along with Saul from Medallion Management, discussed the setup and utilization of Entrata's facilities management product, including locations, problems, and unit type mappings. They also reviewed the Inspection Manager and make-ready processes, identifying areas for improvement and potential integration of existing checklists. The call concluded with scheduling a consultation for rent reporting and rewards programs, emphasizing the importance of operational involvement before the upcoming migration.
customerPeople: Saul Mack III — VP of Property Management

callsUsed.title: Entrata for Medallion | Intro Sync
callsUsed.brief: Nathan and Liam from Entrata, along with Scott from Medallion Management, discussed Entrata's software offerings and potential synergies, with Nathan emphasizing Entrata's role as an educational resource rather than a sales pitch. Scott clarified his company's current focus on understanding existing systems before adopting new ones, and Nathan provided a high-level overview of Entrata's capabilities, including affordable housing solutions. The conversation concluded with Scott indicating the deal was anticipated for late August or September, and both parties agreeing to maintain open communication for future questions.

callsUsed.title: Entrata + RMP Investing & River Caddis Group: Rent Reporting & Homebody Rewards Consultation
callsUsed.brief: Jaron and William from Entrata, along with Scott and Ryan, discussed the implementation of Entrata's rent reporting and rewards programs for Medallion Management. Key highlights included the optional rent reporting feature accessible via a separate app, the enrollment process through lease addendums, and a revenue share model where properties retain $3.00 per resident per month. The Homebody Rewards program was also presented as a cost-effective alternative to cash concessions, with points earned for various resident actions and customizable incentives. Discussions also covered the setup of merchant accounts in Entrata, with a focus on the need for bank account information to proceed.

callsUsed.title: RMP / Entrata Accounting consultation 2
callsUsed.brief: Lydia and William from Entrata, along with Ryan and Tom, discussed the setup and workflow for Accounts Payable (AP) payments within Entrata, including adding bank accounts, completing merchant account applications, and managing vendor compliance. Key highlights included the process for creating and approving invoices and purchase orders, the budget module's integration with AP, and Entrata's vendor compliance features that can automatically place invoices on hold for non-compliant vendors. The conversation also touched upon year-end electronic filing capabilities and the finalization of merchant accounts to ensure proper fund settlement.

callsUsed.title: Entrata + RMP Investing & River Caddis Group: Leasing AI & Maintenance AI Consultation
callsUsed.brief: Jaron from Entrata, along with Scott and Ryan, discussed the integration of Leasing AI and Maintenance AI for Medallion Management. Key highlights included setting up dedicated email inboxes for AI communication, the process for email integration, and the capabilities of the Maintenance AI bot for work order submission and status updates. They also touched upon future automation for maintenance assignments and the plan to discuss IVR and call routing in an upcoming meeting.

callsUsed.title: RMP Investing's Virtual 3-Day Entrata Training
callsUsed.brief: Amaris from Entrata, along with Casey and Saul from Medallion Management, discussed the Entrata platform, focusing on lead management, the application and screening process, lease execution, and resident move-ins. The training highlighted the use of Eli AI for lead nurturing and emphasized the importance of accurate data entry and understanding the system's various functionalities, including the prospect portal and Homebody app, to streamline property management operations. The session concluded with a review of the move-in process and an early adjournment, with plans to continue the training the following day.
customerPeople: Saul Mack III — VP of Property Management

callsUsed.title: RMP Investing's Virtual 3-Day Entrata Training
callsUsed.brief: Amaris from Entrata, along with Ryan and Saul, discussed resident management, including charges, payments, credits, and DocScan, as well as resident portal features, funds verification, and insurance options. The session also covered mid-lease modifications, transfers, and renewals, with a focus on workflow and system functionalities. Future topics will include maintenance, accounting functions like AP, budgets, closing, and approval routes.

callsUsed.title: RMP Investing's Virtual 3-Day Entrata Training
callsUsed.brief: Amaris from Entrata, along with Ryan from RMP Investments, LLC, discussed the final day of Entrata training, covering facilities management, reporting, delinquency, move-outs, and accounts payable. Key topics included managing work orders, utilizing the facilities app, generating various reports (rent roll, delinquency), handling resident delinquencies and evictions, and processing vendor payments and compliance. The session aimed to equip RMP Investments with the knowledge to effectively use Entrata's comprehensive features for property and financial management.
